name: The Path of the Protector
label: Quest
description: The Path of the Protector: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Dedication of this magnitude is a rarity. You have shown that your will is unfaltering, friend. You shall be greatly rewarded for your stalwart watch over our world.
Hand me your signet ring so that I may strengthen its enchantment.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Your rise amongst the rank of the Brood is most impressive, friend. May you never stray from the path of the protector!
